chunks: Those who deny and die disbelieving will never be accepted an earthful of gold if proferred by them as ransom. For them is grievous punishment, and none will help them.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the wealth of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of the state of *kufr* at the time of death, illustrating that material wealth cannot compensate for spiritual deficiency when the soul is separated from the body. It highlights the concept of *fida'* (ransom) being rejected, reinforcing the principle that faith and righteous deeds are the only currency accepted in the Hereafter. This serves as a warning against delaying repentance, as the opportunity for redemption closes with the final breath.
